notes.title: Version 1.2 Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, greetings! Here comes the second update since the game's release~
[list]
[*] The development team page has been optimized
[*] Fixed an issue where the "furtune cookie" achievement could not be unlocked
[*] Resolved a problem with the "single-task deep work method" being displayed incorrectly in the collect album
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176504/91e1fdfde36d3bef7ff4748c4319dc974fc562dd.png[/img]

notes.title: Version 1.1 Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, greetings! Here comes the first update since the game's release~
[list]
[*]Added music (17-minute casual background music)
[*]Added an option to adjust music volume in the settings
[*]Updated icons that were distorted or unappealing
[*]【DLC】Revised the descriptions related to the "GTD Method" in the "Efficiency Cookie"
[/list]
Details are as follows:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176504/04b7d048ec6c7d50820f6031b45f9f7889326309.png[/img]

By the way, would you all like to see a collection of Beijing's cuisine? If many of you are interested in this topic, we will consider adding a new Gourmet Cookie in future updates. 
(Also, reviews pleeeeaaaasːlunar2019crylaughingpigː; it feels quite lonely with only 2 reviews despite having 4,000+ add library.ːlunar2019deadpanpigː)
